items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. AI is becoming important in Earth and environmental research, but current data systems aren't well-suited for AI tasks. This study compares decision models, large language models (LLMs), and fine-tuned encoders for multilingual emotion classification. Decision models offer fast responses and consistent results across different question phrasing, but their effectiveness in multiple languages hasn't been widely tested. Researchers developed a technique called TrojanMaxxing that uses AI to secretly alter vision-language models (VLMs) without training or optimization. U.S. Treasury yields increased on Monday, reversing some of last week's price changes.
